script.base: Baltimore, a 14-point home favorite with a 29.2 implied total, leads by halftime and drains clock through Derrick Henry, who just handled 57 carries for 297 yards (19.0 per game, 5.2 YPC) in weeks 9-11. Pace is controlled, not a shootout, on a 44.5 outdoor total.
script.flip1: Jets stay within one score into the fourth behind Fields and Hall explosives against a Ravens run defense allowing 4.82 YPC and 32 runs of 10+. Henry still works but Lamar Jackson has to throw; Keaton Mitchell never gets a mop-up series; Jets drives last long enough for Mason Taylor (14 targets, 68 yards in that three-game window) to matter.

Jets abandon designed runs and take garbage-time shots — Adonai Mitchell had 104 air yards on only 10 receiving yards in the recent window — so one NYJ receiving line spikes while Hall's rush line dies.
